pages.text: A Munchstone is an Arcane Gem formed from a black-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an oval cut.$(br2)When activated, a Munchstone allows you to consume plant-based blocks to restore your hunger and saturation. Charge is consumed for each point of hunger and each point of saturation recovered.

Please note that the Munchstone devours blocks that are in the world, it does not give you the idea to eat blocks that are in your inventory like conventional food.$(br2)Notably, you can use a Munchstone even if your stomach is full.

To recharge a dun Munchstone, activate the gem while you have bonemeal in your inventory. Five pieces of bonemeal are necessary to fully refill the gem, and if you have less than five pieces the gem will only be partially recharged. The bonemeal is consumed.
